## 3. Channel rules
- **Escalation ladder:** [dev → tech lead → PM → sponsor; SLA per rung]
- **n+1 rule:** every problem report carries a proposal — situation,
  complication, question, answer (one option per problem).
- **Worse-earlier:** bad news travels faster than good; report within
  [24 h] of confirmation, not at the next scheduled meeting.
- **Meeting hygiene:** agenda 24 h prior; decisions + owners within 24 h after; no meeting without an artifact.

## 4. Governance communication
| Artifact | To | When | Contains |
|---|---|---|---|
| change log | all hands | after each CCB | decisions + effect numbers |
| RAG dashboard | sponsor | weekly | scope/schedule/cost/quality read |
| CCB minutes | CCB members | 24 h after CCB | CR decisions + recorded dissent |
| escalation memo | sponsor | within 24 h | situation / complication / question / answer |

## 5. Failure modes this plan must prevent
| Failure mode | Prevention in this plan |
|---|---|
| sponsor hears first from anyone else | |
| decisions made in hallway conversations | |
| affected groups hear from outsiders first | |
| survey/meeting fatigue | |

## 6. Team communication (inside the team)
| Ceremony / medium | Cadence | Purpose | Artifact |
|---|---|---|---|
| standup | daily | re-planning huddle | board state |
| retro | per sprint or per phase | process fix | 1 owned improvement |
| review | per MR | knowledge spread | review log |
